# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Esendi ne bung’ali, O, Wele wase, sikila Ewe wanonga khumanye ne khu khusikamila Ewe. Nga ndola luno luri, khu mani kase kamakekhe khu bunyali Bwowo, khu butambi bwase, khu buhinda Bwowo. Saliho Wele okundi nokhali Ewe, Omuyeti mubutinyu, Oliyo yeng’ene.
